writing.exampleCaption: The property holds for every input, not for three of them.
writing.explanation: Unit tests pin down behaviour you already thought of. Property tests generate inputs and check an invariant, which finds the cases you did not. Fuzzing pushes malformed input at a parser until it panics. Integration tests check the seams. A candidate who reaches for all four in the right places is saying something a coverage number cannot.
